baseline_hydrofoil.description: Two-dimensional hydrofoil section with a neutral aft flap inside a deterministic water-tunnel style test section.
observed_behavior: stable physical behavior over the public operating envelope
low drag and low separation risk but limited control authority
wake quality remains acceptable because the aft surface is not aggressively loaded

flap_tradeoffs.effect: easy attached flow but weak lift/control authority

flap_tradeoffs.trend: Moderate deflection with adequate chord and blend
flap_tradeoffs.effect: can provide useful control authority while keeping drag and wake loss controlled
can trigger aft-surface separation, higher drag, and sensitivity to hidden trim cases
can reduce loading but leaks flow and worsens wake uniformity
increases hinge curvature and local separation risk

disclosure_note: This public summary is intentionally broad. It does not contain hidden case values, scoring anchors, ranked candidates, public scores, or the official reference geometry.
template_note: The public hydrofoil_flap_template.json is only a conservative schema placeholder. It is deliberately low-authority and not the official reference design.
coarse_guidance_note: The public envelope gives broad useful regions for deflection, hinge gap, flap chord, blend radius, trailing-edge offset, and blockage. Those regions are not hidden anchors.
scoring_disclosure_note: The scoring surface combines public engineering guidance with independent hidden physical checks. Public calibration samples are broad trend data, not ranked candidates or exact hidden scores.
